name: maadb-remote
description: Use a MAADB engine you host from Claude Code. Connects over Streamable HTTP with a MAADB bearer token.

url.title: MAADB MCP URL
url.description: Full URL of your engine's MCP endpoint, ending in /mcp. Use https for anything that is not on this machine.

token.title: MAADB token
token.description: A maad_pat_ token from `maad auth issue-token`. Stored in your system keychain.
